decisions.statement: The order the slots are written in is the order the slots are drawn in.
Where a slot is drawn among the other slots is worked out from that order.
The editor draws a higher place further left.
The slot written first is drawn first.
A separator is drawn between the workstation figures, the usage figures, and each stoplight section.
A figure taken over no account is drawn as a dash.
A figure of a share is drawn with the part after the point dropped.
A figure of an amount is drawn to a tenth.
A figure carries the unit that figure counts in.
Nothing here has an editor item.
The workstation figures are drawn before the usage figures.

definition: the slots the status bar draws and the order among them
